notes: A subject federate begins with a passive adapter-selected interaction-class subscription, which the standard MIM reports as inactive. After the standard subscribeInteractionClass service changes the same subscription to active, a separate requester issues HLArequestSubscriptions again and verifies that the MIM interaction-class list reports the same class as active. The scenario uses only official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM interactions, standard encoding DataElements, and the C++ standard library. Provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, names, and update-rate designator remain adapter supplied; no vendor API, private headers, or DDM regions are used.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void subscribeInteractionClass( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass, bool active = true) = 0
